title: JSON-RPC Call to Base via Python Requests
description: Executes eth_blockNumber JSON-RPC request to Helios Base node.
code:
import os
import requests

def get_base_block_number():
    api_key = os.environ.get('HELIOS_API_KEY')
    url = f"https://api-architect.internal/demo/v4/base/rpc?key={api_key}"
    
    payload = {
        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
        "method": "eth_blockNumber",
        "params": [],
        "id": 1
    }
    
    response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=5)
    response.raise_for_status()
    data = response.json()
    
    block_num_hex = data['result']
    return int(block_num_hex, 16)

print(f"Current Base Block: {get_base_block_number()}")
